clue.text: Industrial action does for capital invested in good western

indicators.note: money invested in something is put inside it, so one piece goes within the others

blocks.note: G is the standard abbreviation for good
Oslo is the capital of Norway
W is the abbreviation for west or western

explanation.surface: A strike stands in for something done to a city in a cowboy film.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital sits between the letters for good and western.
explanation.definitionFit: A go-slow is a form of protest where workers deliberately reduce their output.

clue.text: Slum area has hospital within reach

indicators.note: within says one item is placed inside the other words

blocks.note: to reach a place is to get to it
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A deprived district happens to have a hospital nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghetto is a poor, overcrowded urban area, often occupied by one minority group.

clue.text: English poet and writers in short series

indicators.note: in places one item inside the other, here inside the shortened word

blocks.note: SER is the abbreviation for series
pens are writing instruments

explanation.surface: An English poet appears alongside authors in a brief run of books.
explanation.walkthrough: Writers are the tools, not the authors the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: Edmund Spenser was the Elizabethan author of The Faerie Queene.

clue.text: Class to be trained in hurdles

indicators.note: something trained is shaped into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: A group of pupils is to be coached over hurdles, as in athletics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be' looks like part of the instruction, but it is part of the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurdles are obstacles, whether literal barriers on a track or figurative difficulties.

clue.text: Albumen, for example, having surprising weight

indicators.note: a surprising arrangement is an unexpected one, so the letters come out in a new order

blocks.note: e.g. abbreviates exempli gratia, for example
the letters as written

explanation.surface: Albumen, for instance, turns out to weigh more than expected.
explanation.walkthrough: The comma makes 'for example' look like a phrase attached to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Albumen is the clear protein-rich part of an egg, the part that turns white when cooked.

clue.text: Given an unsuitable role probing legal mix-up in old royal residence

indicators.note: probing means pushing inside something, so the first phrase goes into the other
a mix-up muddles the order of the letters in the word before it

blocks.note: the letters as written
an actor given an unsuitable part is miscast

explanation.surface: Someone badly cast meddles in a legal muddle at a former royal home.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamis Castle in Scotland was the childhood home of the Queen Mother, so a historic royal residence.

clue.text: Victorian painter was keeping on the wagon

indicators.note: keeping means holding something inside, so the outer word wraps the other

blocks.note: taken as written
TT, teetotal, describes someone not drinking

explanation.surface: A Victorian artist stayed sober.
explanation.walkthrough: Being 'on the wagon' is an idiom for abstaining from alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: George Frederic Watts was a celebrated painter and sculptor of the Victorian era.

clue.text: Resolve shown by press elsewhere

blocks.note: to press clothes is to iron them
someone elsewhere is out

explanation.surface: A decision is revealed by journalists somewhere else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Press' suggests newspapers; here it is the household chore.
explanation.definitionFit: To iron out problems is an idiom for settling or resolving them.

clue.text: Gertrude finally learning about wrongdoing in Hamlet's castle

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the name it follows
about means around, so one word wraps the other

blocks.note: the last letter of the name
lore is accumulated learning
a sin is a wrongdoing

explanation.surface: Hamlet's mother is finally finding out about sin in his castle.
explanation.walkthrough: Gertrude is Hamlet's mother, which ties the surface to the play.
explanation.definitionFit: Elsinore, the Danish fortress Kronborg, is where Shakespeare sets the tragedy.

clue.text: Nevertheless quits? Indeed

blocks.note: two people who are quits are even
so can be an emphatic 'indeed', as in 'it is so'

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether another really is giving up, and is told yes.
explanation.definitionFit: Even so is an adverbial phrase meaning however or in spite of that.

clue.text: Choose at random from actors, a great many

blocks.note: the actors in a production are its cast
lots means a great many

explanation.surface: A director picks blindly from a huge pool of performers.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast lots is to decide something by drawing tokens, a matter of pure chance.

clue.text: Meat and dessert left by Scotsman and Scouser

blocks.note: liver is offal eaten as meat
pud is short for pudding, British for dessert
L is the abbreviation for left
Ian is a typically Scottish first name

explanation.surface: A main course and pudding are abandoned by a Scot and a Liverpool man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left by' looks like abandonment; left is just a letter placed before the Scotsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scouser is the informal British name for a native of Liverpool.

clue.text: Conductor of opera, popular in Northern Ireland

indicators.note: in places the word before it inside the abbreviation that follows

blocks.note: Tosca is Puccini's opera
NI abbreviates Northern Ireland
something popular is in

explanation.surface: An operatic conductor is well liked in Belfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conductor of opera' reads as one phrase, but the definition stops at Conductor.
explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a famous Italian maestro who led orchestras and opera houses.

clue.text: Power in early golf club

indicators.note: in places the first item inside the following word

blocks.note: early and soon both mean before long
P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.surface: Strength mattered at a golf club in its early days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'early golf club' looks like a historical club; the definition is only golf club, though the spoon was indeed an old one.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoon was an old wooden golf club, roughly equivalent to a modern three-wood.

clue.text: Period of violent ups and downs as large wave hits vessel

definitions.text: Period of violent ups and downs

blocks.note: a roller is a long heavy wave
a coaster is a ship that trades along a coast

explanation.surface: A ship is battered by a huge wave and has a turbulent time.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively, a roller coaster is a time of dramatic highs and lows, like the fairground ride.

clue.text: Historic region one must enter before being able to vote?

indicators.note: to enter is to go inside, so the numeral goes into the phrase that follows

blocks.note: one cannot vote while still under age, that is, as a minor
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A query about who must sign up before they are allowed to vote.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the time before voting age must be rephrased as a three-word phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Asia Minor is the ancient name for Anatolia, the peninsula forming most of modern Turkey.

clue.text: See heartless Yank climbing through small window

indicators.note: without a heart, the central letters of the word are removed
in a down clue climbing reads upwards, so the letters run backwards
going through something puts it inside the other word

blocks.note: slight means small
taken as written

explanation.surface: Look: an unfeeling American is climbing in through a tiny window.
explanation.walkthrough: With its middle two letters gone Yank leaves two letters, which run upwards and sit after the first letter of the word for small. 'See' only invites the solver to look.
explanation.definitionFit: A skylight is a window set into a roof or ceiling to let in daylight.

clue.text: Objects loudly as I pick skunk off crossing opening in trees

indicators.note: an opening is the start, so only the first letter of the next word is used
off suggests going wrong or bad, so the letters are scrambled

blocks.note: the letters as written
the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Someone protests loudly while picking a skunk off a path through the woods.
explanation.walkthrough: The extra letter from trees joins the anagram, as 'crossing' hints.
explanation.definitionFit: To kick up a stink is an informal idiom for complaining noisily and making a fuss.

clue.text: Conservative golfer making a stupid mistake

blocks.note: C abbreviates Conservative
Bernhard Langer is a German golfer, twice Masters champion

explanation.surface: A Tory golfer slips up badly.
explanation.definitionFit: A clanger is British slang for an embarrassing blunder, as in dropping a clanger.

clue.text: Thicken soup in galley

indicators.note: soup is a jumbled mixture, so the letters are stirred into another order

blocks.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: A cook on a ship thickens the soup.
explanation.walkthrough: Soup reads as a noun to be thickened; it is the signal to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A galley is the kitchen on a ship or aircraft.

clue.text: Large bird coming from very large quarry

blocks.note: OS stands for outsize, the clothing size label
an animal hunted is its hunter's quarry or prey

explanation.surface: A big bird emerges from a huge stone pit.
explanation.walkthrough: Quarry suggests a stone pit; here it is a hunted animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The osprey is a large fish-eating bird of prey.

clue.text: Discover legendary king's name

blocks.note: King Lear is a legendary British king; the 's means 'has'
N abbreviates name

explanation.surface: Someone finds out what a mythical king was called.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn something can mean to find it out, as in learning the truth.

clue.text: Girl's article on clubs in New York

indicators.note: in puts the earlier pieces inside the letters for the city

blocks.note: NY abbreviates New York
an is the indefinite article
C abbreviates clubs, the card suit

explanation.surface: A girl writes a piece about nightclubs in Manhattan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' simply places the article before clubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Nancy is a girl's given name.

clue.text: Mountain range is old - to me, anyway

indicators.note: anyway suggests in any manner at all, so the letters may be put in any order

blocks.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs that a mountain range seems ancient, at least to them.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dolomites are a range of the Alps in north-eastern Italy.

clue.text: Very large carriage ahead of worker in charge

blocks.note: a gig is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage
a worker ant is the classic crossword worker
i/c abbreviates in charge

explanation.surface: A huge coach leads the man running the show.
explanation.definitionFit: Gigantic means enormous, the size of a giant.

clue.text: An endless job for TV presenter?

indicators.note: with no end, the final letter is dropped

blocks.note: taken as written
a chore is a routine job

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether hosting television is a task that never stops.
explanation.definitionFit: An anchor is the main presenter who links a television news programme.

clue.text: Hearing about a king staying longer than intended

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the court word wraps the following pieces

blocks.note: a court hearing is trying a case
taken as written
R abbreviates rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A court case concerning a monarch drags on too long.
explanation.walkthrough: Hearing reads as a noun; it must be swapped for the legal verb form.
explanation.definitionFit: To tarry is to linger or delay leaving, so tarrying is staying on.

clue.text: Spirit, make unknown

blocks.note: a make of product is its brand
y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: An instruction to keep a ghost a stranger.
explanation.definitionFit: Brandy is a spirit distilled from wine.
